# Portfolio Copilot instructions

These instructions are always active for this repository.

- Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/PORTFOLIO_TASTE_STANDARD.md` before portfolio UI work.
- Apply the vendored Taste Skill from `vendor/taste-skill/` to public portfolio design without waiting for the prompt to repeat it.
- Start with a one-line Design Read and explicit variance, motion, and density dials.
- Audit existing pages before redesigning them. Improve the current Next.js and Tailwind v3 implementation instead of replacing it.
- Avoid generic AI UI patterns, fake screenshots, decorative labels, uncontrolled motion, inaccessible states, and incomplete placeholder code.
- Check `package.json` before importing dependencies and run the relevant lint, build, and browser checks.
